title: 小富即安
concept: suitcase on tiny red velvet cushion
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art for achievement_medal_travel_tier_002, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but simple premium collectible travel achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "小富即安" (a little rich and immediately comfortable). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and glossy teal enamel center, slightly richer than tier 1 but still simple. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold travel suitcase wearing oversized cheap black sunglasses, sitting proudly on a tiny plush red velvet cushion like it has achieved luxury. The suitcase and cushion are the only main elements. Add only two large star glints as lighting, not extra objects.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, deliberately silly, premium material finish, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: simple large silhouette, suitcase centered and dominant, cushion secondary. Low detail enough for future tiers to become more elaborate.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, comedic over-serious luxury.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, electric teal enamel, red velvet cushion, black sunglasses, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, soft velvet cushion, beveled rim. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
